title: One step of a course or a path, with its check and the way on
about: The page of one lesson (a module, a step of an onboarding path, a chapter) opened from its list with its id: its title and number, its text in full, its questions answered one by one with right or wrong and the explanation, then the one main action: mark it done (a row of PROGRESS, once) and go on to the next one, or back to the list after the last. It can always be marked done: a question got wrong says so and shows the answer, it never locks the way on. Content people pay for comes through CONTENT, a rule or function called with {id} that checks they may have it and returns {body, questions: [{question, choices, answer, explanation}]}; open content is a column of the table (BODY).

progress.about: the table of ones done: one row per person and lesson

item.about: the progress column holding the lesson's id

content.about: the rule or function that gives one lesson's {body, questions} for {id}, refusing those who may not have it

body.about: the lessons column with the text (Markdown), when anyone may read it

order.about: SQL ORDER BY for the lessons

back.about: the view of the whole list (the course), opened after the last one and from Back

data.{{key}}_all: SELECT id, {{name}} FROM {{table}} ORDER BY {{order}} LIMIT 500

{{key}}_c.$value: =params.id ? app.call({{content|json}}, {id: params.id}).catch(e => ({ error: e && e.message ? e.message : String(e) })) : null

let.{{key}}_text: =(() => { const t = {{key}}_raw; const name = String(({{key}}_l && {{key}}_l.{{name}}) || '').trim().toLowerCase(); const m = t.match(/^\s*#{1,3}\s+(.+)\n?/); return m && name && m[1].trim().toLowerCase() === name ? t.slice(m[0].length) : t; })()
let.{{key}}_qs: =(({{content|json}} && {{key}}_c && Array.isArray({{key}}_c.questions)) ? {{key}}_c.questions : []).map((q, i) => { const raw = q.choices; const list = Array.isArray(raw) ? raw.map(String) : String(raw ?? '').split(/\n|\s*\|\s*/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); const ans = String(q.answer ?? ''); return { id: q.id ?? i, question: String(q.question ?? ''), choices: list.map((c, k) => ({ text: c, correct: c === ans || String(k) === ans })), explanation: q.explanation || undefined }; })
let.{{key}}_go: =async () => { if (state.{{key}}_saving) return; set({ {{key}}_saving: true }); try { if (!{{key}}_is) await app.insert({{progress|json}}, { {{item}}: params.id }); } finally { set({ {{key}}_saving: false }); } if ({{key}}_next) app.open(app.view, { id: {{key}}_next.id }); else if ({{back|json}}) app.open({{back|json}}); }

props.question: =(index + 1) + '. ' + q.question
props.onAnswer: =(i, correct) => { if (state.{{key}}_picked[q.id]) return; set({ {{key}}_picked: { ...state.{{key}}_picked, [q.id]: { i, correct: !!correct } } }); }

then.text: =`${{{key}}_right} of ${{{key}}_qs.length} right` + ({{key}}_right === {{key}}_qs.length ? ': well done.' : '. The answers are shown above.')
